p: first day of the first month: After that Moses had been 40 days and 40 nights in the mountain, that is, from the beginning of August to the tenth of September, he came down, and caused this work to be done: which when finished, was set up in Abib, half March and half April.
of gold for the incense before: That is, the altar of perfume, or to burn incense on.
hanging of the door to the: This hanging or veil was between the sanctuary and the court.
shall surely be an everlasting priesthood: Till both the priesthood and the ceremonies should end, which is at Christ's coming.
the second year: After they came out of Egypt, Nu 7:1.
testimony into the ark: That is, the tables of the law; Ex 31:18,34:29.
door of the tabernacle: Between the sanctuary and the court.
the cloud of the LORD was: Thus the presence of God preserved and guided them night and day, till they came to the land promised.
